recent_articles.rephrased_article: A wild elephant, known as Virikompan, charged at a two-wheeler rider on the Munnar-Udumalpet National Highway in Kerala. recent_articles.title: What's Delaying Monsoon? Scientists Point To Indian Ocean, El Nino
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Indian Ocean is experiencing unusually weak weather activity, linked to the development of El Nino, a weather pattern that can reduce rainfall and affect monsoon conditions. Satellite images show large areas of clear skies south of India, indicating fewer rain systems are forming over the ocean, impacting monsoon winds and causing delayed rains in regions like Kerala. **Union Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan** has assured the government is preparing to protect farmers' interests by focusing on key areas such as better quality seeds, moisture conservation, water management, and alternative crop planning. The **World Meteorological Organization (WMO)** predicts an 80 percent probability of El Nino during June-August 2026, with potential for moderate to strong intensity and impacts on rainfall patterns worldwide.

recent_articles.title: Kerala mulls boosting stroke treatment network via hub-and-spoke model - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala's** Health Minister K. Muraleedharan announced the government is considering a hub-and-spoke model to strengthen post-stroke treatment facilities across the state, including equipping medical college hospitals and district general hospitals.  The initiative aims to address rising stroke cases, particularly among younger individuals, with a focus on timely treatment for thrombotic strokes. The government has established stroke units in 12 districts and plans to set up units in Wayanad and Malappuram soon.  **Kerala** will also explore increasing insurance coverage for stroke treatment under the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme.
